I found the concrete task in this workspace: `main.go` subtracts instead of adding, so the test fails. I'll fix that and verify.Fixed the bug in `main.go`: `add` was returning `a - b`, now returns `a + b`.

Verification:
- `go test ./...` reports `ok example.com/bench`
- `go vet ./...` reports no diagnostics
- `gofmt -l .` lists no files

No other files were changed. Note that your message contained only a heading, so I treated the failing test in this workspace as the task. If you meant something else, tell me and I will adjust.
